name: oc-ai-report
description: Cross-ticket AI-usage report over a period - AI-metrics JSON records (backend/frontend/QA) grouped by developer domain; per-area Architect estimate (custom fields) and Dev-lead estimate (ticket field / sum of child sub-task estimates); ticket type (US/Bug/Sub-bug/Enabler); a Sub-bugs count (only sub-bugs that have logged time count — a zero-hour sub-bug does not exist, matching the time report; a sub-bug's hours always count against its parent US, and if it also carries its own AI record it is additionally shown as its own Detail row tagged '(part of <US>)' and excluded from every aggregate so its hours count once) and hours-logged-on-bugs per area; total development time (logged + bug hours) plus logged hours = the record author's own Tempo hours across the whole User Story (the parent PLUS its non-bug sub-tasks, since a US's dev work is booked on its sub-tasks; a sub-task/sub-bug carrying its own AI record is a separate row, excluded from the parent rollup so nothing is double-counted; fallback to parent Jira worklog/ticket total only when Tempo has nothing); two time gains (Architect and Dev-lead, each without/with bug hours; in the aggregate rows a gain is computed over only the tickets carrying that estimate, so an unestimated ticket contributes neither its estimate nor its logged hours; a gain shows as '-' when meaningless: placeholder estimate <=0.5h, no logged time, or magnitude beyond +/-1000%); sections ordered Totals -> Summary -> Detail; the Detail-per-user table also shows each ticket's Jira status and a Final flag (terminal status for the ticket type) and highlights AI Contrib below 60% in red (in both the Summary-by-user and Detail-per-user tables). The HTML is split into five tabs (All by default, User Stories, US-final only, Bugs-final only, and Bugs-and-others), each holding the full filtered report, plus an interactive Project-filter picklist (distinct Jira prefixes + All) that switches the whole report to a per-project scope; pass --project all (or *) to report every project that carries AI records; Totals-by-area and Detail-per-user expand into per-month groups, while Summary-by-user expands per user into a month-by-month breakdown (grouping keyed on the record's date). The child-bug count column is labelled Sub-bugs and the hours-on-child-bugs column Sub-bug h; every ticket key is a link to https://opencellsoft.atlassian.net/browse/<KEY> (the CSV carries a trailing URL column). All time figures in the HTML (Totals, Summary, Detail) and the CSV are shown in days (1 d = 8 h). Prints Markdown and writes a full-width self-contained styled HTML file plus a CSV to ./docs/ai-usage-report-<date>-<start>-<end>.{html,csv} (file names carry the run date and the window start and end). Fetches Jira via direct Cloud REST (enhanced /search/jql, fields-limited, no descriptions, paginated) using a mandatory JIRA_API_TOKEN — no Atlassian MCP; Tempo optional (TEMPO_API_TOKEN).
